_about: The ontology's identity: its release rises on every published change, `extends` names what it composes on top of, `carries` what the directory holds.
name: product
summary: What a product must do, for whom, under what rules, why: personas, journeys, requirements, releases, constraints, assumptions, risks, decisions, open questions, objectives, policies, terms. The core every product type extends.

changelog.note: Ships with the engine: the generic core software-architecture and ddd sit on (decided with Chiheb Dkhil, 2026-10-07). Extends oto-core like every shipped ontology.
The sample is an invented product authored through the gates (a nightly ledger reconciliation), one instance of each class; it breaks no policy of the core. Confirmations kept.

The product core, confirmed: its 17 Gate 1 questions confirmed by Chiheb Dkhil on 2026-10-06, the 20 classes derived from them (none pruned), policies naming the question they protect. Exported from the project Product core.
Ships its competency questions (questions.json): 25 questions covering every class, relation and attribute.
Rewritten in the engine's form (every declaration an object) and given its namespace.
Exported from the project IGM Document Automation.
Seed lexicon, reader's guide and gold question patterns.
Domain expert confirmation carried into the rationale and rules (same domain, same reviewer).
